newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed unchanged on Saturday owing to low buying by spinners, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
The rates fluctuated in the kerb market where mills with cash bought cotton cheaper than the rates quoted at the KCA, one dealer said.

In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,100 and 2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 between 2,450 and 2,475 and the MNH-93 between 2,460 and 2,485, he said. The prices were likely to open unchanged on Monday.
